# FoodHubbie ERP

> Restaurant & cafe ERP: QR ordering, kitchen display, rider dispatch, WhatsApp ordering,
> promotions, POS, analytics — three apps (Admin, Customer Menu, Rider) on one realtime system.

## What it is
- Admin Dashboard (command center): live orders, kitchen display (KDS), tables/dine-in QR,
  POS counter billing, menu/catalog/categories/combos/menu-browser, inventory, promotions
  (WhatsApp campaigns), discounts/coupons, customers, riders, live delivery tracking,
  analytics, feedback/reviews, push notifications, payments, expenses, costs. No app download
  for customers — browser QR menu.
- Customer Menu: scan table QR → browse → customize → cart → place → live status →
  request water/bill → pay. Delivery via WhatsApp webview link (single-use token, GPS fee).
- Rider App: online/offline, assigned orders, pickup, OTP handoff, cash collection,
  wallet/settlements, delivery history.
- WhatsApp: Baileys transport for chat/ordering; Meta Cloud API for promotional campaigns
  (promos hard-blocked on Baileys). STOP opt-out honored; paced sends; emergency stop.

## Marketing engine (verified capabilities)
- Campaigns: ≤1500 chars, tokens {name} {phone} {lastOrderDate} {storeName} {couponCode},
  image + menu footer, STOP footer; audience = consenting / active-30d / CSV (300 cap);
  preview + send-test-to-self; ₹1 token/message money gate; launch now or schedule + quiet
  hours; live progress; per-campaign stop + EMERGENCY STOP ALL. 25 templates, 7 categories.
- Discounts: Global / Category / New-Customer / Coupon; % or ₹; channels WhatsApp/POS/Both/
  Web/All; schedule, min-subtotal, exclusive groups, per-customer/global caps, stackable;
  same engine scores POS, tables, QR; per-code reports + CSV.
- Combos: dishes + qty + %/fixed + dates + image → one-tap POS tiles.
- Safety: 300 recipients/campaign, 300/day, 8–15s pacing + batch pauses, 7-day warmup ramp,
  >35% failure circuit-breaker, kill-switch, Meta-only promos.

## Pricing (per-order, flat)
- QR Table ₹2/order + POS counter ₹1/order.
- WhatsApp Official (Meta Cloud API) ₹5/order or 1% of sales. Official Promo msgs ₹1 each.
- One-time setup ₹500 (non-refundable, adjusted in first bill).
